Method Detail

Rectangle

public static DbProfile Rectangle(Point origin,
                                  double xdim,
                                  double ydim,
                                  double radius,
                                  int windingDirection)
Creates a profile entity representing a rectangle whose adjacent curves share common end points (associated). Corner blending arcs can be conditionally created.
Parameters:
origin - a point specifying one corner of the rectangle
xdim - the signed X dimension of the rectangle
ydim - the signed Y dimension of the rectangle
radius - the blending arc radius (iff radius > Const.SMALL). If the radius is less-than Const.SMALL, the arcs are inverted.
windingDirection - one of (Const.CW, Const.CCW)
Returns:
a profile entity whose 0th curve is a line entity.

BHC

public static DbFeature BHC(Point bhcOrigin,
                            double bhcRadius,
                            double bhcStartDegs,
                            double bhcDeltaDegs,
                            int bhcHoleCount,
                            double oneHoleRadius)
Creates a feature entity representing a bolt hole circle (or arc).
Parameters:
bhcOrigin - the center point of the BHC.
bhcRadius - the radius of the BHC.
bhcStartDegs - the start angle of the BHC (in degrees).
bhcDeltaDegs - the signed increment between holes (in degrees).
bhcHoleCount - the number of holes.
oneHoleRadius - the radius of a hole in the pattern.
Returns:
a feature containing a BHC of circles.
